en: Saved on this phone. Will send when internet returns.
am: በዚህ ስልክ ተቀምጧል። ኢንተርኔት ሲመለስ ይላካል።
om: Bilbila kana irratti olkaa'ameera. Yeroo interneetiin deebi'u ni ergama.

en: Check your internet, then try again.
om: Interneetii kee ilaaliitii irra deebi'ii yaali.

en: No internet. Showing what was saved on this phone.
am: ኢንተርኔት የለም። በዚህ ስልክ የተቀመጠውን እያሳየ ነው።
om: Interneetiin hin jiru. Kan bilbila kana irratti olkaa'ame agarsiisaa jira.

en: A new version of Nota is ready.
Nota will speak this language. You can change it later in Settings.
am: ኖታ በዚህ ቋንቋ ያናግርዎታል። በኋላ በቅንብሮች መቀየር ይችላሉ።
om: Nota afaan kanaan si haasofsiisa. Booda Qindaa'ina keessatti jijjiiruu dandeessa.

en: Dates in Nota will use this calendar. You can change it later in Settings.
am: በኖታ ውስጥ ቀኖች በዚህ አቆጣጠር ይታያሉ። በኋላ በቅንብሮች መቀየር ይችላሉ።
om: Guyyaawwan Nota keessatti lakkoofsa kanaan mul'atu. Booda Qindaa'ina keessatti jijjiiruu dandeessa.

en: {shop} wants to keep your dube book with you on Nota
am: {shop} የዱቤ ደብተርዎን ከእርስዎ ጋር በኖታ ላይ መያዝ ይፈልጋል
om: {shop} kitaaba dube kee siwajjin Nota irratti qabachuu barbaada

en: See every purchase and your balance. Nota never adds interest or fees.
am: እያንዳንዱን ግዢና ቀሪ ሂሳብዎን ይመልከቱ። ኖታ ወለድም ክፍያም አይጨምርም።
om: Bittaa hundaafi haftee kee ilaali. Nota dhala ykn kaffaltii hin dabalu.

en: The shop writes your purchases in Nota. You see them on your phone, the same as the shop.
am: ሱቁ ግዢዎችዎን በኖታ ይጽፋል። እርስዎም ልክ እንደ ሱቁ በስልክዎ ያዩዋቸዋል።
om: Suuqiin bittaa kee Nota irratti barreessa. Atis akkuma suuqii bilbila kee irratti ni argita.

en: Check the SMS from the shop, or ask the shop to invite you again.
am: ከሱቁ የመጣውን ኤስኤምኤስ ይመልከቱ፣ ወይም ሱቁ እንደገና እንዲጋብዝዎ ይጠይቁ።
om: SMS suuqii irraa dhufe ilaali, ykn suuqiin akka irra deebi'ee si affeeru gaafadhu.
Liinkiin affeerraa kanaa yeroon isaa darbeera

en: You can still join. Put Nota on your phone and sign in with your number.
am: አሁንም መቀላቀል ይችላሉ። ኖታን በስልክዎ ላይ አድርገው በቁጥርዎ ይግቡ።
om: Ammallee makamuu dandeessa. Nota bilbila kee irra kaa’iitii lakkoofsa keetiin seeni.

en: Open Nota to see your dube book.
om: Kitaaba dube kee ilaaluuf Nota bani.

en: Ask {shop} if you think this is a mistake.
No internet. Connect, then open the link again.
am: ኢንተርኔት የለም። ያገናኙና ሊንኩን እንደገና ይክፈቱ።
om: Interneetiin hin jiru. Walqabsiisiitii liinkii irra deebi'ii bani.

en: Put Nota on your home screen
am: ኖታን በስልክዎ መነሻ ገጽ ላይ ያድርጉ
om: Nota fuula jalqabaa bilbila keetii irra kaa’i

en: Then open your dube book with one tap, like any app. It uses very little space.
am: ከዚያ የዱቤ ደብተርዎን እንደማንኛውም መተግበሪያ በአንድ ንክኪ ይከፍታሉ። በጣም ትንሽ ቦታ ይይዛል።
om: Achiis kitaaba dube kee akkuma appii kamiiyyuu tuqaa tokkoon banta. Bakka xiqqoo qofa qabata.

en: Put Nota on my home screen
om: Nota fuula jalqabaa koo irra kaa’i

en: Nota works like an app, but you do not need the Play Store. It takes a few seconds.
am: ኖታ እንደ መተግበሪያ ይሰራል፣ ግን ፕሌይ ስቶር አያስፈልግም። ጥቂት ሰከንዶች ይወስዳል።
om: Nota akka appii hojjeta, garuu Play Store hin barbaachisu. Sekondii muraasa fudhata.

en: Tap “Install app” or “Add to Home screen”.
am: “Install app” ወይም “Add to Home screen”ን ይንኩ።
om: “Install app” ykn “Add to Home screen” tuqi.

en: No “Install app”? Tap “Open in Chrome” below, then try again.
am: “Install app” አላዩም? ከታች “በክሮም ክፈት”ን ይንኩ፣ ከዚያ እንደገና ይሞክሩ።
om: “Install app” hin argitu? Gadii “Chrome keessatti bani” tuqiitii irra deebi'ii yaali.

en: Tap the Share button at the bottom.
Look for “Add to Home screen” or “Install”.
This app cannot put Nota on your home screen. Chrome can.
am: ይህ መተግበሪያ ኖታን በመነሻ ገጽ ላይ ማድረግ አይችልም። ክሮም ይችላል።
om: Appiin kun Nota fuula jalqabaa irra kaa’uu hin danda’u. Chrome ni danda’a.

en: Tap ⋯ or the Share button, then “Open in Safari”.
am: ⋯ ወይም የማጋሪያ ቁልፉን ይንኩ፣ ከዚያ “Open in Safari”ን ይንኩ።
om: ⋯ ykn furtuu qooduu tuqi, achiis “Open in Safari” tuqi.

en: Nota is on your home screen
om: Nota fuula jalqabaa kee irra jira

en: The Nota icon on the home screen
am: በመነሻ ገጹ ላይ ያለው የኖታ ምልክት

en: Not now? You can put Nota on your home screen later.
am: አሁን አይደለም? በኋላ ኖታን በመነሻ ገጽዎ ላይ ማድረግ ይችላሉ።
om: Amma miti? Booda Nota fuula jalqabaa kee irra kaa’uu dandeessa.

en: Put Nota on my home screen
om: Nota fuula jalqabaa koo irra kaa’i

en: We will send you a code by SMS.
This is not an Ethiopian mobile number. It starts with 09 or 07.
am: ይህ የኢትዮጵያ ሞባይል ቁጥር አይደለም። በ09 ወይም በ07 ይጀምራል።
om: Kun lakkoofsa moobaayilii Itoophiyaa miti. 09 ykn 07 n jalqaba.

en: Type your own phone number. We send a 6-digit code to it by SMS. No password is needed.
am: የራስዎን ስልክ ቁጥር ይጻፉ። ባለ 6 አሃዝ ኮድ በኤስኤምኤስ እንልካለን። የይለፍ ቃል አያስፈልግም።
om: Lakkoofsa bilbila kee barreessi. Koodii lakkoofsa 6 qabu SMS-n siif ergina. Jecha icciitii hin barbaachisu.

en: {count, plural, =0{The code is wrong. Ask for a new code.} =1{The code is wrong. 1 try left.} other{The code is wrong. {count} tries left.}}
am: {count, plural, =0{ኮዱ ትክክል አይደለም። አዲስ ኮድ ይጠይቁ።} =1{ኮዱ ትክክል አይደለም። 1 ሙከራ ቀርቷል።} other{ኮዱ ትክክል አይደለም። {count} ሙከራዎች ቀርተዋል።}}
om: {count, plural, =0{Koodiin sirrii miti. Koodii haaraa gaafadhu.} =1{Koodiin sirrii miti. Yaaliin 1 hafeera.} other{Koodiin sirrii miti. Yaaliiwwan {count} hafaniiru.}}

en: The code is wrong. Check the SMS and try again.
am: ኮዱ ትክክል አይደለም። ኤስኤምኤሱን አይተው እንደገና ይሞክሩ።
om: Koodiin sirrii miti. SMS ilaaliitii irra deebi'ii yaali.

en: This code is too old. Ask for a new one.
am: ይህ ኮድ ጊዜው አልፏል። አዲስ ይጠይቁ።
om: Koodiin kun yeroon isaa darbeera. Haaraa gaafadhu.

en: Too many wrong tries. Ask for a new code.
am: በጣም ብዙ የተሳሳቱ ሙከራዎች። አዲስ ኮድ ይጠይቁ።
om: Yaaliiwwan dogoggoraa baay'eedha. Koodii haaraa gaafadhu.

en: {minutes, plural, =1{Too many codes asked. Try again in 1 minute.} other{Too many codes asked. Try again in {minutes} minutes.}}
am: {minutes, plural, =1{በጣም ብዙ ኮዶች ተጠይቀዋል። ከ1 ደቂቃ በኋላ ይሞክሩ።} other{በጣም ብዙ ኮዶች ተጠይቀዋል። ከ{minutes} ደቂቃ በኋላ ይሞክሩ።}}
om: {minutes, plural, =1{Koodiiwwan baay'een gaafatamaniiru. Daqiiqaa 1 booda yaali.} other{Koodiiwwan baay'een gaafatamaniiru. Daqiiqaa {minutes} booda yaali.}}

en: You need internet to sign in. Connect, then try again.
am: ለመግባት ኢንተርኔት ያስፈልጋል። ያገናኙና እንደገና ይሞክሩ።
om: Seenuuf interneetii barbaachisa. Walqabsiisiitii irra deebi'ii yaali.

en: Open the SMS from Nota and type the 6 numbers. The code works for 5 minutes.
am: ከኖታ የመጣውን ኤስኤምኤስ ከፍተው 6ቱን ቁጥሮች ይጻፉ። ኮዱ ለ5 ደቂቃ ይሰራል።
om: SMS Nota irraa dhufe banii lakkoofsota 6 barreessi. Koodiin daqiiqaa 5f hojjeta.

en: Sign out of Nota on this phone?
om: Bilbila kana irratti Nota keessaa ba'uu?

en: Nota never adds interest or fees.
om: Nota dhala ykn kaffaltii hin dabalu.

en: You see every purchase the shop writes, right away.
am: ሱቁ የሚጽፈውን እያንዳንዱን ግዢ ወዲያው ያያሉ።
om: Bittaa suuqiin barreessu hunda battalumatti ni argita.

en: Nothing is ever deleted. Mistakes are fixed with a correction you both see.
am: ምንም ነገር አይሰረዝም። ስህተት ሁለታችሁም በምታዩት ማስተካከያ ይታረማል።
om: Wanti tokkollee hin haqamu. Dogoggorri sirreeffama lamaan keessan argitaniin ni sirraa’a.

en: Money never goes through Nota. You pay the shop as you always do.
am: ገንዘብ በኖታ በኩል አያልፍም። እንደተለመደው ለሱቁ ይከፍላሉ።
om: Maallaqni Nota keessa hin darbu. Akkuma duraanii suuqiif kaffalta.

en: This is the Nota dube agreement. Tap “I agree” to open your dube book.
am: ይህ የኖታ የዱቤ ስምምነት ነው። የዱቤ ደብተርዎን ለመክፈት “እስማማለሁ”ን ይንኩ።
om: Kun waliigaltee dube Nota ti. Kitaaba dube kee banuuf “Walii galeera” tuqi.

en: Tap a shop to see the agreement and open your dube book.
am: ስምምነቱን ለማየትና የዱቤ ደብተርዎን ለመክፈት ሱቁን ይንኩ።
om: Waliigaltee ilaaluuf fi kitaaba dube kee banuuf suuqii tuqi.

en: No shop has invited this number yet.
am: እስካሁን ይህን ቁጥር የጋበዘ ሱቅ የለም።
om: Hanga ammaatti suuqiin lakkoofsa kana affeere hin jiru.

en: Ask the shop to add {phone} in Nota. Then tap Refresh.
am: ሱቁ {phone}ን በኖታ እንዲያክል ይጠይቁ። ከዚያ “አድስ”ን ይንኩ።
om: Suuqiin {phone} Nota irratti akka dabalu gaafadhu. Achiis “Haaromsi” tuqi.

en: A shop invites you by your phone number. If you do not see the shop, it may have used another number.
am: ሱቅ የሚጋብዝዎ በስልክ ቁጥርዎ ነው። ሱቁን ካላዩት ሌላ ቁጥር ተጠቅሞ ሊሆን ይችላል።
om: Suuqiin lakkoofsa bilbila keetiin si affeera. Suuqii sana yoo hin argine, lakkoofsa biraa fayyadamee ta’uu danda’a.

en: The shop invited a different number. Ask the shop to check the number, or sign in with that number.
am: ሱቁ ሌላ ቁጥር ጋብዟል። ሱቁ ቁጥሩን እንዲያረጋግጥ ይጠይቁ፣ ወይም በዚያ ቁጥር ይግቡ።
om: Suuqiin lakkoofsa biraa affeere. Suuqiin lakkoofsa akka mirkaneessu gaafadhu, ykn lakkoofsa sanaan seeni.

en: Done. Your dube book with {shop} is open.
am: ተጠናቋል። ከ{shop} ጋር ያለዎት የዱቤ ደብተር ተከፍቷል።
om: Xumurameera. Kitaabni dube kee {shop} waliin banameera.

en: Close Nota and open it again, then try again.
am: ኖታን ዘግተው እንደገና ይክፈቱ፣ ከዚያ እንደገና ይሞክሩ።
om: Nota cufiitii irra deebi'ii bani, achiis irra deebi'ii yaali.

en: You need internet for this. Connect, then try again.
am: ለዚህ ኢንተርኔት ያስፈልጋል። ያገናኙና እንደገና ይሞክሩ።
om: Kanaaf interneetiin barbaachisa. Walqabsiisiitii irra deebi'ii yaali.
Hanga ammaatti kitaabni dube hin jiru.

en: When a shop invites you, it shows here.
om: Yeroo suuqiin si affeeru as mul’ata.

en: Each shop keeps its own dube book with you. Tap a shop to see every purchase.
am: እያንዳንዱ ሱቅ ከእርስዎ ጋር የራሱን የዱቤ ደብተር ይይዛል። እያንዳንዱን ግዢ ለማየት ሱቁን ይንኩ።
om: Suuqiin hundi kitaaba dube mataa isaa siwajjin qabata. Bittaa hunda ilaaluuf suuqii tuqi.

en: {count, plural, =1{A shop invited you.} other{# shops invited you.}}
am: {count, plural, =1{አንድ ሱቅ ጋብዞዎታል።} other{# ሱቆች ጋብዘዎታል።}}
om: {count, plural, =1{Suuqiin tokko si affeereera.} other{Suuqiiwwan # si affeeraniiru.}}

en: Every purchase and payment with this shop, newest first. Nothing is ever deleted: mistakes are fixed with a correction.
am: ከዚህ ሱቅ ጋር ያለው እያንዳንዱ ግዢና ክፍያ፣ አዲሱ መጀመሪያ። ምንም ነገር አይሰረዝም፤ ስህተት በማስተካከያ ይታረማል።
om: Bittaa fi kaffaltii suuqii kana waliin hunda, kan haaraan dura. Wanti tokkollee hin haqamu: dogoggorri sirreeffamaan sirraa’a.

en: Nothing taken by this person yet.
om: Namni kun hanga ammaatti homaa hin fudhanne.

en: Change the language or the calendar, or sign out of this phone.
am: ቋንቋውን ወይም የቀን አቆጣጠሩን ይቀይሩ፣ ወይም ከዚህ ስልክ ይውጡ።
om: Afaan ykn lakkoofsa guyyaa jijjiiri, ykn bilbila kana irraa ba’i.

en: Open your dube book with one tap from the home screen.
am: የዱቤ ደብተርዎን ከመነሻ ገጹ በአንድ ንክኪ ይክፈቱ።
om: Kitaaba dube kee fuula jalqabaa irraa tuqaa tokkoon bani.

en: Set how much you may owe this shop, and how soon you pay it back. The shop has its own limit; the stricter one applies.
am: ለዚህ ሱቅ ምን ያህል መበደር እንደሚችሉና በምን ያህል ጊዜ እንደሚከፍሉ ያስቀምጡ። ሱቁም የራሱ ገደብ አለው፤ ጥብቁ ይሠራል።
om: Suuqii kanaaf hammam liqeeffachuu akka dandeessuu fi yeroo meeqa keessatti akka kaffaltu kaa’i. Suuqiinis daangaa mataa isaa qaba; inni cimaan hojii irra oola.

en: Ask me before selling over my limit
om: Daangaa koo ol gurguruu dura na gaafadhaa

en: The shop must ask you on this phone before writing more than your limit.
am: ሱቁ ከገደብዎ በላይ ከመጻፉ በፊት በዚህ ስልክ መጠየቅ አለበት።
om: Suuqiin daangaa kee ol barreessuu dura bilbila kana irratti si gaafachuu qaba.

en: To be asked first, set the most you may owe.
om: Dursee gaafatamuuf, liqii hundarra guddaa kaa’i.

en: Saved. Your limit at {shop} is set.
Set an amount, a time, or both.
am: የገንዘብ፣ የጊዜ ወይም ሁለቱንም ገደብ ያስቀምጡ።
om: Daangaa maallaqaa, yeroo, ykn lamaan kaa’i.

en: People who can take goods for you
Only people listed here can take goods on your dube book. You get a message each time. Pause or remove anyone at once.
am: እዚህ የተዘረዘሩ ሰዎች ብቻ በዱቤ ደብተርዎ ዕቃ መውሰድ ይችላሉ። በእያንዳንዱ ጊዜ መልዕክት ይደርስዎታል። ማንንም ወዲያው ማቆም ወይም ማስወገድ ይችላሉ።
om: Namoota asitti tarreeffaman qofatu kitaaba dube kee irratti meeshaa fudhachuu danda’a. Yeroo hunda ergaan siif dhufa. Nama kamiyyuu battalumatti dhaabuu ykn haquu dandeessa.

en: Only you can take goods on this dube book.
am: በዚህ የዱቤ ደብተር ዕቃ መውሰድ የሚችሉት እርስዎ ብቻ ነዎት።
om: Kitaaba dube kana irratti meeshaa kan fudhachuu danda’u ati qofa.

en: The name the shop will know them by
Needed only to send them SMS receipts.
am: የሚያስፈልገው የኤስኤምኤስ ደረሰኝ ለመላክ ብቻ ነው።
om: Kan barbaachisu SMS ragaa erguuf qofa.

en: Send them an SMS for each purchase
The shop asks for it before selling to them.
om: Suuqiin osoo isaaniif hin gurgurin dura gaafata.

en: {name} can now take goods for you.
Remove {name}? They can no longer take goods for you.
am: {name}ን ያስወግዱ? ከእንግዲህ ለእርስዎ ዕቃ መውሰድ አይችሉም።
om: {name} haqi? Siif meeshaa fudhachuu hin danda’an.

en: This was not accepted. Call Nota support.
am: ይህ ተቀባይነት አላገኘም። የኖታ ድጋፍን ይደውሉ።
om: Kun hin fudhatamne. Deeggarsa Nota bilbili.

en: An SMS needs their phone number.
om: SMS erguuf lakkoofsa bilbila isaanii barbaachisa.

en: Approve a purchase over your limit?
{shop} asks to write {amount} more than your limit, once.
am: {shop} ከገደብዎ በላይ {amount} አንድ ጊዜ ለመጻፍ ይጠይቃል።
om: {shop} daangaa kee ol {amount} al tokko barreessuuf gaafata.

en: If you do nothing, the request ends by itself.
om: Homaa yoo hin goone, gaaffiin ofumaan dhuma.

en: Pay the shop the usual way (telebirr, bank, cash). Then tell the shop here. Your balance changes when the shop confirms.
am: እንደተለመደው ለሱቁ ይክፈሉ (ቴሌብር፣ ባንክ፣ ጥሬ ገንዘብ)። ከዚያ እዚህ ለሱቁ ይንገሩ። ሱቁ ሲያረጋግጥ ቀሪ ሂሳብዎ ይለወጣል።
om: Akkuma duraanii suuqiif kaffali (telebirr, baankii, maallaqa harkaa). Achiis as suuqiitti himi. Yeroo suuqiin mirkaneessu hafteen kee ni jijjiirama.

en: From the telebirr or bank SMS. It helps the shop find your payment.
am: ከቴሌብር ወይም ከባንክ ኤስኤምኤስ። ሱቁ ክፍያዎን እንዲያገኝ ይረዳል።
om: SMS telebirr ykn baankii irraa. Suuqiin kaffaltii kee akka argatu gargaara.

en: Add a photo of the receipt
This photo could not be used. Try another one.
am: ይህን ፎቶ መጠቀም አልተቻለም። ሌላ ይሞክሩ።
om: Suuraa kana fayyadamuun hin danda’amne. Kan biraa yaali.

en: Payments you told the shop about
Send the shop a list. The shop prices it, brings it to you, and writes it in your dube book as one purchase.
am: ለሱቁ ዝርዝር ይላኩ። ሱቁ ዋጋ ያወጣል፣ ያመጣልዎታል፣ በዱቤ ደብተርዎ እንደ አንድ ግዢ ይጽፈዋል።
om: Suuqiif tarree ergi. Suuqiin gatii baasa, siif fida, kitaaba dube kee irratti akka bittaa tokkootti barreessa.

en: Tap what you need. Use − and + for how many.
am: የሚፈልጉትን ይንኩ። ብዛቱን በ− እና + ይምረጡ።
om: Waan barbaaddu tuqi. Baay’ina − fi +n filadhu.

en: For example: 1 tin of tomato paste
Send the list to the shop

om: Ergameera. {shop} gatii tarree keetii ni baasa.

en: Add at least one thing to the list.
am: ቢያንስ አንድ ነገር ወደ ዝርዝሩ ያክሉ።
om: Yoo xiqqaate waan tokko tarree irratti dabali.

en: The shop sees this and can correct your dube book.
am: ሱቁ ይህን አይቶ የዱቤ ደብተርዎን ማስተካከል ይችላል።
om: Suuqiin kana argee kitaaba dube kee sirreessuu danda’a.

en: Thank you. The shop knows you received it.
om: Galatoomi. Suuqiin akka ati fudhatte beeka.

en: Sent. The shop will look at it.
The shop sees your message. Nothing is deleted: if the shop agrees, it writes a correction you both see.
am: ሱቁ መልዕክትዎን ያያል። ምንም አይሰረዝም፤ ሱቁ ከተስማማ ሁለታችሁም የምታዩትን ማስተካከያ ይጽፋል።
om: Suuqiin ergaa kee ni arga. Homtuu hin haqamu: suuqiin yoo walii gale, sirreeffama lamaan keessan argitan barreessa.

en: I do not know who took it
Get a message when {shop} adds a purchase
om: Yeroo {shop} bittaa barreessu ergaan siif haa dhufu

en: Messages come to this phone, even when Nota is closed. SMS still come too.
am: ኖታ ዝግ ቢሆንም መልዕክቶች ወደዚህ ስልክ ይመጣሉ። ኤስኤምኤስም ይመጣል።
om: Nota cufamee illee ergaan bilbila kanatti dhufa. SMS-nis ni dhufa.

en: Turned off in the browser. You still get SMS.
om: Biraawuzara keessatti cufameera. SMS ammallee ni argatta.

en: This browser cannot show messages. You still get SMS.
am: ይህ ብራውዘር መልዕክት ማሳየት አይችልም። ኤስኤምኤስ አሁንም ይደርስዎታል።
om: Biraawuzarri kun ergaa agarsiisuu hin danda’u. SMS ammallee ni argatta.

en: A PDF with every purchase and payment, who took what, and the balance.
am: እያንዳንዱ ግዢና ክፍያ፣ ማን ምን እንደወሰደና ቀሪ ሂሳቡ ያለበት ፒዲኤፍ።
om: PDF bittaa fi kaffaltii hunda, eenyu maal akka fudhate, fi haftee qabu.

en: You need internet to make a statement. Connect, then try again.
am: መግለጫ ለማዘጋጀት ኢንተርኔት ያስፈልጋል። ይገናኙና እንደገና ይሞክሩ።
om: Ibsa qopheessuuf interneetiin barbaachisa. Walqabsiisiitii irra deebi’ii yaali.

en: Nota could not make the statement. Try again, or call Nota support.
am: ኖታ መግለጫውን ማዘጋጀት አልቻለም። እንደገና ይሞክሩ ወይም የኖታ ድጋፍን ይደውሉ።
om: Nota ibsa qopheessuu hin dandeenye. Irra deebi’ii yaali, ykn deeggarsa Nota bilbili.

en: {count, plural, =1{1 change is not sent yet. Signing out removes it. Sign out anyway?} other{# changes are not sent yet. Signing out removes them. Sign out anyway?}}
am: {count, plural, =1{1 ለውጥ ገና አልተላከም። መውጣት ያጠፋዋል። ቢሆንም ይውጡ?} other{# ለውጦች ገና አልተላኩም። መውጣት ያጠፋቸዋል። ቢሆንም ይውጡ?}}
om: {count, plural, =1{Jijjiiramni 1 ammallee hin ergamne. Ba’uun ni haqa. Ta’us ni baataa?} other{Jijjiiramni # ammallee hin ergamne. Ba’uun ni haqa. Ta’us ni baataa?}}
